subject: Post-demo: HealthSync DPA path, SCC options, and vendor SQ kick-off
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Zhao <emma.zhao@healthsync.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: HealthSync DPA path, SCC options, and vendor SQ kick-off

Thanks again for the demo today — really appreciate the time and the clear product fit signals. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Compliance posture: you mentioned SOC 2 Type II is in progress and expected by Q4. Can you confirm the targeted report date (month) and whether it will include data-at-rest encryption and logging scope? This will help determine whether we punt to SCCs or proceed with a DPA first.

2) GDPR/DPA: HealthSync asked about controller vs processor role for the parts of the flow where you enrich patient records with risk scores. We believe the likely model is: HealthSync = Controller; Redwood = Processor. If you have internal language preferring a different split, please flag it now so our legal teams align.

3) SCC module: we discussed Module Two (processor-to-processor) vs Module Three (processor-to-controller) earlier — from our read, Module Three (Controller-Processor) is most appropriate if HealthSync remains Controller. If HealthSync would like to act as Processor for specific integrations, we can map modules per integration.

4) Vendor Security Questionnaire (VSQ): To speed contracting, can you share the questionnaire your procurement/legal team prefers? I attached a one-page intake and a suggested timeline below. If you prefer, we can also kick off via our standard vendor SQ (attached) and share answers within 3 business days for the initial pass.

Suggested immediate next steps:
- Emma: confirm SOC 2 target month and whether HS legal prefers Module Three SCC language.
- HealthSync Legal: if possible, send the vendor SQ spreadsheet or let us know if we should use yours (we attached our typical VSQ to fill).
- Karthik/Neha: once we have SQ and SOC2 date, we will push a DPA draft and mark the SCC module recommendation for legal review.

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_SQ_template.xlsx (short intake), DPA draft template placeholder (we will tailor).

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick follow-up call tomorrow if that helps.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise GTM | Redwood Inference

From: Emma Zhao <emma.zhao@healthsync.com>

Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: HealthSync DPA path, SCC options, and vendor SQ kick-off

Thanks Karthik — great session. Quick answers: 

- SOC 2: we are in the middle of our Type II run and expect the report to finalize in late November 2026 (target week of Nov 22). The current scope includes production systems, logging, and encryption-at-rest for databases; I can confirm exact control names with legal.

- Controller/Processor: HealthSync’s position is Controller for customer data, and Processor for limited third-party enrichment services. For the risk-scoring piece we saw, we currently intend to remain Controller; we are open to per-integration exceptions.

- SCC module: Legal preference at first pass is Module Three (Controller to Processor). If Redwood wants to propose Module Two for specific SaaS-to-SaaS flows, indicate those flows and we’ll evaluate.

I’m attaching our procurement team’s VSQ (spreadsheet) — launches our standard fields plus a PHI/HIPAA section. Legal is cc’d and will pick up DPA language.

Emma
Emma Zhao
Head of Product 
HealthSync
emma.zhao@healthsync.com

Attachment: HealthSync_VSQ_Master.xlsx

Forwarding HealthSync's VSQ. Key notes for legal/ops: 

- SOC 2 timing: Nov 22 target (we should flag that as "in-progress").
- HealthSync prefers Module Three SCC language at first pass — aligns with Controller/Processor split they described.
- Their VSQ includes PHI/HIPAA-specific sections; they process limited patient data in-scope for HIPAA. That means we should include the HIPAA addendum language in the DPA draft and check our BAA posture with infra/legal.

Action items for us: 
1) Neha — please run the VSQ intake and fill our answers for the quick-pass items (authentication, encryption-at-rest, incident response SLA). Use Redwood_Vendor_SQ_template as the baseline; combine with HealthSync_VSQ_Master.xlsx. I attached both for your convenience.
2) Laura — can you have Legal prepare a DPA draft with Module Three SCC text and HIPAA addendum placeholders? If possible, include one-sided redlines we usually accept for mid-market buyers.
3) I'll coordinate with HealthSync legal and propose a DocuSign timeline: initial DPA + VSQ answers by July 16; follow-up SOC2 evidence when available in Nov.

I’ve attached the DPA draft skeleton we start from and our VSQ template.

Thanks — Neha/Laura let me know if the timeline is feasible.

— Karthik

Attachments: HealthSync_VSQ_Master.xlsx (from Emma), Redwood_Vendor_SQ_template.xlsx, Redwood_DPA_Draft_2026-07-07.docx

Thanks — I pulled the HealthSync VSQ and completed the quick-pass items in tab "Redwood Responses" (attached). Summary of answers and blockers: 

- Auth & Encryption: We confirmed SSO (SAML/OIDC) support; encryption-at-rest + in-transit are "Yes" (AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.2+ in transit).
- Incident Response: We provided our standard 24/7 on-call escalation steps and 72-hour initial incident notification SLA; legal may want to tighten timing for PHI incidents.
- HIPAA: We flagged two items where infra/legal need to confirm BAA posture: (1) third-party subprocessor list and (2) log retention window for audit logs containing PHI identifiers.
- SOC2: marked as "In progress — expected Nov 2026" per Emma.

Next steps I propose: 
- Laura: please insert Module Three SCC boilerplate and HIPAA addendum placeholders into the DPA draft. If you can push a first pass by EOD Monday (Jul 12), I will incorporate the VSQ answers and return a combined package to HealthSync for signature prep.
- Karthik: please propose the DocuSign timeline and confirm the July 16 milestone for DPA + VSQ quick-pass.

Attachment: HealthSync_VSQ_filled_RedwoodResponses.xlsx
